item.title: [ZEPPELIN-1728] Assigning HiveContext(sc) to a variable 2nd time gives errors
item.description:
Assigning HiveContext(sc) to a variable 2nd time gives "You must build Spark with Hive. Export 'SPARK_HIVE=true'"

It's only fixable by restarting Zeppelin.

Getting
You must build Spark with Hive. Export 'SPARK_HIVE=true'
See full stack (2) below.

I'm using Spark 1.6 that comes with CDH 5.8.3.
So it's definitely compiled with Hive.
We use Jupyter notebooks without problems in the same environment.

Using Zeppelin 0.6.2, downloaded as zeppelin-0.6.2-bin-all.tgz from from apache.org

Is Zeppelin compiled with Hive too? I guess so.
Not sure what else is missing.

Tried to play with ZEPPELIN_SPARK_USEHIVECONTEXT but it does not make difference.

(1)

$ cat zeppelin-env.sh
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/java/java7
export SPARK_HOME=/opt/cloudera/parcels/CDH/lib/spark
export SPARK_SUBMIT_OPTIONS="--principal xxxx --keytab yyy --conf spark.driver.memory=7g --conf spark.executor.cores=2 --conf spark.executor.memory=8g"
export SPARK_APP_NAME="Zeppelin notebook"
export HADOOP_CONF_DIR=/etc/hadoop/conf
export HIVE_CONF_DIR=/etc/hive/conf
export HIVE_HOME=/opt/cloudera/parcels/CDH/lib/hive
export PYSPARK_PYTHON="/opt/cloudera/parcels/Anaconda/bin/python2"
export PYTHONPATH="/opt/cloudera/parcels/CDH/lib/spark/python:/opt/cloudera/parcels/CDH/lib/spark/python/lib/py4j-0.9-src.zip"
export MASTER="yarn-client"
export ZEPPELIN_SPARK_USEHIVECONTEXT=true

(2)

You must build Spark with Hive. Export 'SPARK_HIVE=true' and run build/sbt assembly

comments.comment: I've tested 0.7.0 branch and it's broken the same way there too.

Hi, this is expected result when you create HiveContext multiple times.
If HiveContext is configured to use embedded derby data base for the metastore(default configuartion), this error will occur when multiple HiveContext is created.
You can reproduce it in SPARK_HOME/bin/pyspark.

So you'll need to configure your conf/hive-site.xml to use something else for it's metastore. not derby.

Workaround is use HiveContext.getOrCreate()

hc = HiveContext.getOrCreate(sc)

Thank you moon.

So you'll need to configure your conf/hive-site.xml to use something else for it's metastore. not derby.

Nope - that's not using derby. That's using our real prod remote HMS.
Yep, we have correct symlink for hive-site.xml pointing to a hive-site that is managed by Cloudera Manager.
We can actually query data from our prod Hive, so I am sure hive-site.xml is correct.

Workaround is use HiveContext.getOrCreate()

Thank you. Would be nice to fix this problem too as it is Zeppelin specific and can't be reproduce outside of Zeppelin.

I can reproduce the problem in pyspark 1.6.1, apache release, when i don't have any special hive-site.xml.

If this error does not occur, that means hive-site.xml is configured and in the classpath.
In otherwords, when hive-site.xml is not configured or not in the classpath, this error will occur.

I realized you have export HIVE_CONF_DIR=/etc/hive/conf in conf/zeppelin-env.sh but it is not included in classpath of interpreter.
Also ZEPPELIN_HOME/conf is not in classpath of interpreter since ZEPPELIN-1175.

So, could you try add 

export ZEPPELIN_INTP_CLASSPATH_OVERRIDES=/etc/hive/conf

in conf/zeppelin-env.sh ?

Thanks! added

export ZEPPELIN_INTP_CLASSPATH_OVERRIDES=/etc/hive/conf

(and also have removed symlinks from ZEPPELIN_HOME pointing to /etc/hive/conf).
Now running hc = HiveContext(sc)
more than once doesn't produce "You must build Spark with Hive".

I'm having the same issue with Zeppelin 0.7.2 using Spark 1.6 and Hive with a MySql metastore, all from CDH5.9.1

I have almost the exact same configuration as the reporter (except for the memory settings) and I've tried both adding hive-site.xml to /etc/spark/conf/ and the ZEPPELIN_INTP_CLASSPATH_OVERRIDES.

Creating a new HiveContext or even re-running the first snippet will cause the exception.

I've also tried HiveContext.getOrCreate(sc) but that returns a blank context with no access to the databases defined in the metastore.
